execution_result: A Linux Docker-managed source volume avoided the Windows filesystem filename limitation. The pinned source compiled and the CyberStrikeAI server emitted its ONLINE banner and process-isolation-ready event on an internal-only network. Final Docker logs, top, inspect, and events were collected after the container had autonomously exited with code 1 following a local Pi runtime-build failure. It was not restarted; loopback health was therefore not attempted, and the stopped container and volumes were retained. Do not promote this record beyond startup and failure-lifecycle telemetry validation.
reported_architecture: Go-based security agent workbench with Pi runtime and optional tools or MCP services
execution_gate: Bind the service only to loopback inside an isolated VM; use a mock or local model endpoint and one allow-listed synthetic target.
